sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (standard Arogya Sanjeevani range ₹1L–₹5L)

room_rent.note: If room taken exceeds limit, all other expenses (except medicines) are proportionately reduced

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye; Modern treatments at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: lower of 25% SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; Modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.): up to 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Only declared and accepted PEDs covered after 36 months; portability credits reduce this period

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, piles, calculi, varicose veins etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Alternatively, insured may opt for a premium discount grid instead of SI enhancement; bonus reduces at same rate if claim made

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.display: Listed procedures only (Annexure A, List V)
day_care.note: Extensive list of named day-care procedures covered; not all day-care automatically covered

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (E.21)

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed cap of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-medical/consumable items explicitly excluded (Annexure A, List I)

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (F.19, E.22)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; portability/migration credits count

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly or annual premium

free_look.note: Available for policies with term of one year or more

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with credit transfer for PED and specific waiting periods

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, war, nuclear/bio/chemical

optional_riders.display: None mentioned; CB can be taken as premium discount instead of SI enhancement
